title: Runbook effort by stage
method: Synthetic single execution with eighteen hands-on minutes. Guided-tool comparison changes identification from four to one and execution from three to one, producing thirteen minutes. Waiting time and tool upkeep are excluded and must be added for a business case.
alt: Runbook effort by stage: Identify batch 4 hands-on minutes, Check prior side effects 6 hands-on minutes, Execute replay 3 hands-on minutes, Verify result 5 hands-on minutes. Illustrative inputs.
